entries.description: Probe provenance unverifiable by machine — key_scope_probe.json has no API call logs, signed timestamps, or CI-based execution evidence. Accepted as CONFIRMED BLIND in premortem Assumption 2.
entries.risk_if_deferred: LOW — probe results are manually reviewed; no automated regression path exists but probes are run infrequently

entries.description: Risk reduction verification uses drill-only simulate-close --dry-run, not the real close path. Real close procedure requires funded positions which are not available in Phase 0.
entries.risk_if_deferred: MED — drill proves operator can navigate the UI/CLI but does not prove positions actually close. Mitigated by REDUCE_ONLY mode blocking new opens.

entries.description: TOCTOU race in _load_runtime_state() between path.exists() and path.read_text(). File could be deleted or replaced between check and read.
entries.risk_if_deferred: LOW — single-process architecture eliminates concurrent access. Exception handler falls to KILL (fail-closed).

entries.description: AT-022 requires HTTP GET /api/v1/health returning HTTP 200. Implementation is CLI only (./stoic-cli health). No HTTP endpoint exists. Data model and fail-closed behavior are proven but transport layer is missing.
entries.risk_if_deferred: LOW for Phase 0 — system is not serving HTTP in Phase 0. Blocks PROVEN verdict for AT-022.
entries.premortem_ref: S0-004 premortem §4 Decision A: scaffolding only, no HTTP

entries.description: Value-range validation deferred — no upper bounds on risk limits in policy loader. Basic range checks present (non-positive rejected) but extreme values are not bounded.
entries.risk_if_deferred: MED — extreme values (e.g., max_position=999999999) would pass policy loading. PolicyGuard must enforce business-logic ranges at runtime.
entries.premortem_ref: S0-005 premortem §4 Decision: basic structural validation only
